name: JW Platform Media Source
description: Embed JW Player (JW Platform v2 API) videos into Drupal via a media source, field, block and CKEditor 5 plugin.
project_description:
Easily embed videos from JW Player into your Drupal site. JW Platform Media Source is a contrib module for Drupal 10 that allows you to connect your Drupal media to JW Player v2 APIs. With this module, you can easily embed videos from JW Player into your Drupal site.

 Features 
 
 Configure JW Player players 
 Embed videos from JW Player 
 Manage JW Player videos 
 
 This module also provides a number of additional features, such as :

 
 WYSIWYG CKEditor5 Plugin to embed videos from JW Player 
 Custom field for embedding videos from JW Player 
 Block for embedding videos from JW Player 
 List of JW Player videos in the Content/Media section 
 
 Post-Installation 
 After installing JW Platform Media Source, you will need to configure it.

 
 Go to the JW Platform Media Source configuration page. 
 Enter your JW Player API v2 key. 
 Enter the ID of the JW Player site that you want to use. 
 Click the "Save" button. 
 
 Once you have configured JW Platform Media Source, you can start embedding videos from JW Player into your Drupal site.

To embed a video from JW Player, you can use the jwplayer custom field or block.

 Additional Requirements 
 JW Platform Media Source requires the following:

 
 Drupal core 10 or higher 
 JW Player API v2 Key 
 JW Player Site ID
